ITEM 1 | Orange carrot pieces, several rounds and a cut section, bright orange with slight darker edges, smooth firm surface, some slices overlapping, roughly 1 cm thick rounds up to about 3 cm across, clustered in the lower right of the bowl | 45
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-orange carrot piece, elongated tapered shape about 5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, slightly glossy with a few browned spots, one end with a dark tip, lying beside the orange carrot pieces | 20
ITEM 3 | Thin orange carrot strip, elongated about 4 cm long and under 1 cm wide, firm and smooth, lying at the bottom edge of the cluster | 8
ITEM 4 | Small green broccoli floret, about 2.5 cm across, bright green with bumpy florets, firm, sitting at the right edge of the carrot cluster | 10
ITEM 5 | Thin smear of orange-brown sauce or residue, faint and patchy, only a few small traces on the bowl surface near the top center of the cluster, slightly glossy | 3
